title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.31117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-depe

translated_title: 透过PRISM清晰洞察：程序性视频中错误识别的步骤序列推理
translated_abstract: 程序性错误识别要求识别出有效多步骤活动中的偏差。我们研究了在基准数据集提供步骤边界的条件下，从视频中进行活动完成后的错误识别。我们提出了PRISM（通过可解释语义建模进行程序性错误识别），该方法将视频片段锚定于语言，并利用一个在正确执行样本上训练的轻量级隐马尔可夫模型，将片段描述映射到程序状态。通过参考对齐和语义检查来识别步骤内容与顺序中的错误。为支持跨异构基准的评估，我们将各数据集特定的标注统一映射到四种基于编辑的错误类型：插入、删除、替换和换位。在三个基准测试上，我们比较了人工标注与视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的描述，涵盖原始、语义角色和动作-对象三种形式。解码器对照实验表明，训练得到的局部解码器相比最近候选匹配取得了一致的性能提升，此外还有数据集相关的……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出PRISM框架，通过将视频片段锚定于语言并利用在正确执行上训练的轻量级隐马尔可夫模型建模步骤序列，实现对程序性视频中步骤内容和顺序错误的可解释识别，并统一了跨数据集的四种基于编辑的错误类型评估标准。
